title: verdict — the task reviewer's verdict (backlog review)
description: The task reviewer's output (docs/stage-io, task 08). Enforces the shape the gate + prompt contract demand. The semantic rule that changes_requested needs at least one blocking finding is NOT expressible as a schema, so it stays in review_gate (AGENTS.md). _io is stamped by the server.

decision.description: approved: no blocking findings (nits allowed). changes_requested: at least one blocking finding. needs_human_review: the change cannot be judged without a human decision.

summary.description: One or two sentences stating the verdict and why.

severity.description: blocking: must be fixed for this task to count. nit: a concern not worth blocking on.

message.description: What is wrong, where, and what to change - specific enough to act on without re-deriving it.
